technical.summary: Strong momentum and volume confirmation with overbought conditions and weak trend structure limit swing entry probability despite bullish price action and breakout signals.

fundamental.summary: PCG shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 43 days—insufficient smart money alignment to support a trade thesis.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market fear (44 VIX-equivalent) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but stale trades (3-4 years old) and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (415.2), flat yield curve, rising dollar, FOMC event today, and negative macro score (-6) create severely adverse conditions; utilities defensive but credit stress and volatility spike pose material downside risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical momentum (vol_spike_15x, three_white_soldiers, dc10_new_high) with price near support (11.0005) offers contrarian entry in fear-zone conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis 415.2, FOMC today, flat yield curve, rising credit spreads), zero fundamental conviction (score 2), overbought oscillators, and price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA create compounding downside risk that overwhelms technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (vol_spike_15x, three_white_soldiers) and price at support offer contrarian entry in fear zone; however, macro crisis conditions and zero fundamental conviction make this unsuitable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis (415.2), FOMC event today, and flat yield curve create systemic downside risk that will likely overwhelm technical support and momentum signals.
